lines.text: God tells Moses He appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty and promised them the land of Canaan.
God promises to redeem Israel with an outstretched arm, but the Israelites do not listen because of their broken spirit.
The LORD sends Moses to Pharaoh, but Moses objects that he is unskilled in battle.
The LORD makes Moses like God to Pharaoh, and Aaron will be his scribe, while the LORD hardens Pharaoh's heart.
Moses and Aaron obey the LORD, and Moses is eighty years old when they speak to Pharaoh.
